question: Where is the nearest hotel located between Centennial High School Football Stadium, Roswell, GA and Chestatee Overlook, Dahlonega, GA?
sql: WITH stadium_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Centennial High School Football Stadium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Roswell%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%GA%' LIMIT 1 ), overlook_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Chestatee Overlook%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Dahlonega%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%GA%' LIMIT 1 ), midpoint_location AS ( SELECT ST_MakePoint( (ST_X(ST_Centroid(S.geometry)) + ST_X(ST_Centroid(O.geometry))) / 2, (ST_Y(ST_Centroid(S.geometry)) + ST_Y(ST_Centroid(O.geometry))) / 2 )::geography AS geometry FROM stadium_location AS S, overlook_location AS O ) SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_state, P.addr_city FROM pois AS P, midpoint_location AS M WHERE P.tourism = 'hotel' ORDER BY P.geometry::geography <-> M.geometry LIMIT 1;
